about_the_game:
Welcome to an alternate Japan, 2015.

The war is over. Peace is fragile. And your freedom is regulated.

You are Major Reiko Kurosawa, a decorated officer serving a system that promised safety in exchange for control. The Hikari Protocol monitors every citizen, enforces order, and ensures nothing like the collapse ever happens again. At least, on paper.
But when a body turns up — unregistered, untraceable — and strange events begin to unfold, new forces rise from the shadows, threatening to shake the foundations of Japan itself. The illusion of peace begins to crack.

How much are you willing to sacrifice to uncover what lies beneath this fragile, synthetic order?

Key Features:

- Immersive detective gameplay
Take full control of your investigation. Collect evidence, interrogate suspects, solve layered environmental puzzles, and piece the truth together at your own pace. There are no hand-holding quest markers — only your own logic and powers of deduction will guide you to the ending... and decide the fate of Japan.

- A dystopian noir world
Step into an alternate Japan, 2015 — a fractured nation split between a totalitarian police regime and the remnants of Yakuza control. In a world ruled by surveillance and obedience, new underground movements rise in defiance of the synthetic order. Navigate a society where peace is enforced, and freedom comes at a cost.

- A killer always one step ahead
At the heart of the story lies a brutal and elusive serial offender — a sadist who leaves no trace, no clear pattern, and no second chances. Every misstep gives them more time to strike again. Uncovering the truth means navigating a web of lies, hidden agendas, and forgotten crimes... and only your choices can determine whether Major Kurosawa brings justice — or becomes just another ghost in the system.

- Multi-layered narrative with consequence
Every clue you miss, every word you choose, and every assumption you make matters. The story adapts to your deductions, with multiple outcomes shaped by your investigation. Justice isn’t binary — and truth rarely wears a badge.

- Environmental storytelling at its core
Every alleyway, every desk drawer, every symbol on a wall tells part of the story. Observe, analyze, and connect the dots. The world won’t wait — and the answers won’t speak for themselves.



- Sexual content
The game features scenes of sexual nature as part of its mature storytelling. These moments are context-driven, woven naturally into character relationships and investigations. These scenes are presented with narrative weight and seriousness, aligning with the game’s uncompromising tone. They serve the story rather than titillation, and are integral to understanding the characters and the crimes being investigated.

- Complex characters, shifting allegiances
Meet a cast of morally grey figures, each with their own motives, scars, and secrets.

Major Reiko Kurosawa:

A driven investigator caught between law and justice, willing to break rules for the greater good. 32 years old.

Kaito Ishikawa:
A senior detective with charm and cunning — but whose loyalty is as mysterious as his smile. 30 years old.

Takashi Saito:
A high-ranking official who arrives just in time for the investigation. Calm, calculating, and dangerously observant. 47 years old.

The Akari-tachi:

A radical group of “freed” citizens, erased from all records. Their true goal? Still hidden in the shadows.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description
This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, players may encounter scenes that include, explicit sexual content and nudity, strong language, themes of coercion, and disturbing imagery, depictions of violence, including murder and assault, investigative material related to sexual crimes, psychological distress, manipulation, and morally ambiguous choices. Sexual assault is only presented through non-interactive evidence scenes — such as video logs — as part of the criminal investigation. These moments are not playable or controllable.

short_description: A dystopian detective thriller about justice, identity, and the limits of loyalty. As Major Reiko Kurosawa, you’ve always followed the law — until a murder forces you to question if order is the same as justice. In a city ruled by synthetic peace, how far will you go to uncover the truth?
